# SDD Kit: spec-driven development for Claude Code and OpenCode

A copyable repo template implementing a token-disciplined spec-driven
development (SDD) workflow. Shared contract layer (AGENTS.md + openspec/)
works identically across two harnesses: Claude Code (API-billed, cost hooks
and permissions) and OpenCode (local/self-hosted models, context-window
discipline). Optional conceptualize → explore → propose → apply → verify →
archive loop with human review gates between phases.

Two install paths:

1. If `~/.config/sdd-kit/repo` exists (written by this repo's install.sh),
   the user has a user-level `/sdd-kit:init` (Claude Code) or
   `/sdd-kit-init` (OpenCode) command. That command reads
   `~/.config/sdd-kit/repo` for the clone path, then follows
   [INSTALL.md](INSTALL.md) Steps 1–4 in the CURRENT project.
2. Otherwise, an agent should read and follow [INSTALL.md](INSTALL.md)
   exactly — it contains the full detection, copy, and template-adaptation
   procedure. The kit payload is under `kit/`; never copy this repo's own
   distribution docs into a target repo.

## Docs

- [INSTALL.md](INSTALL.md): agent installation procedure (start here)
- [README.md](README.md): full kit documentation, repo layout, cost logic, side-by-side test protocol
- [kit/GREENFIELD.md](kit/GREENFIELD.md): greenfield flow (empty repo, idea first)
- [kit/openspec/config.yaml](kit/openspec/config.yaml): artifact budget rules

The kit payload itself lives under `kit/` — see the `Repo layout` section of
README.md for the full tree.

## Notes

- This kit deliberately ships NO `opencode.json` — provider/API config
  belongs to each user's global OpenCode config. Agents must never create
  or modify one.
- `openspec init` must NOT be run on repos using this kit; the kit ships
  its own curated openspec/ structure.
